newsitem.title: USA: Okabena corrects stake size in Woodroast.
newsitem.headline: Okabena corrects stake size in Woodroast.

text.p: Okabena Partnership K said on Friday that it omitted some transactions in a Woodroast Systems Inc filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission released on Wednesday.

Okabena Partnership K said the size of its stake was reduced to 183,000 common shares, or 4.3 percent, not 205,000 common, or 6.9 precent, as it had reported in the October 9 filing. The partnership said it had inadvertently omitted reporting the sale of 22,000 common shares sold between August 23 and September 25 at prices ranging from $4.35 to $6.06 per share.
